title: Change an existing email
brief:
src/template.tsx is an email that's already written. Change three things and nothing else:

- The heading "What's new in Orbit": 20px on phones. On desktop it stays as it is.
- The button "Read the update": its background turns #4c3df0 on hover.
- More space between the two paragraphs: at least 8px more than there is now.

The words, the colors and every other size stay as they are.

grows.above: Templates now render twice as fast, and previews update as you type.
grows.below: Dark mode is here for every email, page and document you build.
